title: DB Monitor Source Manifest Schema
description: Declares CDC connector sources, database connections, and tables monitored by DB Monitor.

connectors.description: An array of CDC connectors to register with Debezium and monitor in the pipeline.

source_name.description: A unique identifier for the source system. Used as the topic.prefix and server prefix for Debezium.

database_hostname.description: Host/IP of the source database server.

tables.description: A non-empty list of database tables to monitor, formatted as schema.table_name (e.g. public.orders).

enabled.description: Whether this source/connector is active. Disabled connectors are ignored during routing and registration.

connector_name.description: Custom name for Debezium's registered sink endpoint. Defaults to {source_name}-connector.

slot_name.description: Custom logical replication slot name. Defaults to {source_name}_slot.

history_topic.description: Optional name for Kafka's internal database history topic. Defaults to dbhistory.{source_name}.

config_overrides.description: An optional set of extra Debezium key/value properties to overlay onto the generated configuration.
